note: A synthetic client (Slice 129 worked example). Not a real company.
problem: Our quarterly capital return shows a core capital ratio of 14%, but our finance team calculates 12.6%. The return is due to the regulator in ten days.

answers.common.decision: Whether the return is ready to submit; the head of regulatory reporting decides and submits.
answers.common.materials: Core capital is $630 million. Risk-weighted assets in the return are $4.5 billion; finance's figure is $5 billion. A $500 million commercial property loan portfolio has a blank risk weight in the reporting system, so the return left it out. Our minimum requirement including buffers is 10.5%.
answers.accounting-operations.systems: Our regulatory reporting system and the general ledger, this quarter, our standard chart of accounts.
answers.accounting-operations.approver: The head of regulatory reporting reviews and submits the return.
